$comment: Items (docs/design/inventory.md). id: kebab-case, glossary terms only, never changed once shipped (the ledger stores it); name: display name; plural: the name in a count past 1, lowercase (MAIN 2026-10-19: the plural is data, a mass noun stays, "40 black stone"); kind: currency | sparkglass | material | consumable | lore; stackLimit: the most of the item one place holds, or "unlimited"; description: LORE's card text; skill (optional): the gathering skill the tooltip's kind line names. Listed in display order.

items.name: Sealed gin
items.description: A bead of Sparkglass cut to the Concord's weight and rolled with its seal: tower, bowls, hands, ring. Good at every counter in every city.

items.name: Wild sliver
items.description: A sliver of hardened light, brittle and warm. It burns in a Writ. Concord counters weigh it short.

items.name: Humming glass
items.description: A thumb-sized piece of fallen light, brighter than a sliver. Hold it to your ear and it hums.

items.name: Deep glass
items.description: Dark at the edges, bright at the heart, and heavier than glass should be.

items.name: Twisted log
items.description: Dry and hard, but warm in the middle. The rings are tight and whorled, like the lines on a thumb.

items.name: Black stone
items.description: Heavy, dense and faintly warm. Good for walls, hearths and anything that has to stay put.

items.name: Streaked stone
items.description: Black stone with a pale, porous vein running through it, like the inside of a bird's wing. It's lighter than it should be.

items.name: Grey seeds
items.description: Small, hard and grey. They don't look alive. They are.

items.name: Pale grain
items.description: Grain the color of old paper. It tastes of nothing and fills you up.
